title: Climate, Peace and Security Fact Sheet: Haiti (2025)
organization: Stockholm International Peace Research Institute and Norwegian Institute of International Affairs
temporal_coverage: Observed and projected climate, displacement, food-security, and security evidence available through May 2025.
methodology: A specialist four-page synthesis organizes secondary evidence around livelihood, mobility, armed-actor, and political-economic pathways.
limitations: The fact sheet synthesizes other sources and does not independently identify causal effects; selected local examples are not nationally representative.

title: Plan National d'Adaptation au Changement Climatique 2022-2030
organization: Government of Haiti and United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change
geographic_coverage: Haiti, national and municipal adaptation planning
methodology: The government plan synthesizes risk and vulnerability evidence, consultations, sector priorities, governance arrangements, costs, and monitoring needs.
limitations: The plan records intended actions and estimated financing needs rather than verified implementation or outcomes.

title: Climate and Health Vulnerability Assessment: Haiti
geographic_coverage: Haiti, with selected subnational health-risk analysis
temporal_coverage: Historical climate and health evidence with future risk discussion through mid-century and beyond.
methodology: A desk-based climate-health assessment combines hazard, exposure, disease, health-system, and adaptive-capacity evidence.
limitations: The assessment is not a causal Climate-FCV study; some national hazard counts combine events with different definitions and periods.

title: Climate Risk and Adaptation Country Profile: Haiti
organization: World Bank Group and Global Facility for Disaster Reduction and Recovery
geographic_coverage: Haiti and Caribbean regional projection context
temporal_coverage: Observed changes since 1960 and older projections to 2060 and 2090.
methodology: A country profile synthesizes historical observations, national communications, IPCC AR4-era projections, and sector risk literature.
limitations: The projections are old, partly regional, and based on earlier model generations; they should not substitute for a current high-resolution baseline.

title: Haiti Country Strategic Plan (2024-2028)
temporal_coverage: Planned operations for 2024-2028, with context indicators available at approval.
methodology: The strategic plan links humanitarian needs, food systems, resilience, government systems, logistics, and intended portfolio outcomes.
limitations: Outcomes and nexus claims are programme intentions, not independent evidence of effectiveness or peace impacts.

title: Evaluation of Haiti WFP Country Strategic Plan 2018-2022
organization: World Food Programme Office of Evaluation
temporal_coverage: Activities from January 2018 through July 2022; evaluation completed in 2023.
methodology: An Office of Evaluation country-portfolio assessment examined strategic positioning, effectiveness, efficiency, and explanatory factors.
limitations: The evaluation predates the latest violence and assesses WFP rather than national response systems or climate-specific outcomes.

title: Haiti faces record displacement amid escalating gang violence
geographic_coverage: Haiti, with Port-au-Prince and displacement-site context
temporal_coverage: Displacement and access conditions reported through June 2024.
methodology: A UN country-team article reports figures and findings from IOM and independent UN human-rights experts.
limitations: The page is a current synthesis rather than a primary displacement dataset or representative household study.

title: Haiti Humanitarian Situation Report No. 11: End-of-year Sitrep
geographic_coverage: Haiti, with violence-affected and displacement locations
temporal_coverage: Humanitarian conditions and UNICEF outputs from January through December 2024.
methodology: A humanitarian situation report synthesizes agency monitoring, IOM displacement data, partner reporting, and programme outputs.
limitations: Operational figures are not independently evaluated outcomes, and access constraints can reduce coverage in gang-controlled areas.

title: Haiti: Escalating armed violence in Port-au-Prince cuts people off from lifesaving services
organization: International Committee of the Red Cross
geographic_coverage: Port-au-Prince metropolitan area and displacement sites
temporal_coverage: Recent armed-violence impacts and ICRC-supported services displayed when accessed in August 2026.
methodology: An operational update combines field observations and ICRC programme monitoring on health, water, displacement, and humanitarian access.
limitations: The page reports selected ICRC-supported activities and cannot measure population-wide service access or climate-specific effects.

title: Strengthening Disaster Risk Management and Transport Infrastructure after a Disaster: The 2010 Haiti Post-Earthquake Experience
geographic_coverage: Haiti, all 140 municipalities and selected transport corridors
temporal_coverage: Project implementation from 2012 through 2020 and reported response use in 2021.
methodology: An implementing-institution results brief reports administrative outputs, a civil-protection performance index, infrastructure works, and response examples.
limitations: The brief is not an independent impact evaluation; earthquake recovery is not climate evidence, although the resulting systems also address storms and floods.

title: Haiti Systematic Country Diagnostic Update: Pathways to Responding to Recurrent Crises and Chronic Fragility
geographic_coverage: Haiti, national development and fragility systems
temporal_coverage: Structural diagnostic evidence and crises through 2022.
methodology: A systematic country diagnostic synthesizes economic, institutional, social, service, disaster-risk, and fragility evidence.
limitations: National synthesis can obscure municipal variation and predates the most recent displacement and armed-group expansion.
